message.reasoning: We got the alert: web p95 latency above 800ms; CPU above 90%. Service status shows web: version v1.6.2, replicas 2, cpu 97, mem 33, err 0.15, p95 2150, restarts 0. So high latency. Logs show request queue 512/512, shedding load, campaign traffic x4, slow GC pause 120ms. Capacity is 250 rps per replica. Load 1325 rps; with 2 replicas, capacity 500 rps. So definitely traffic spike. The runbook indicates scale out. We did scale_service to 6, and check_health returned healthy. That's good. But we might have to confirm root cause: traffic spike? logs show "campaign 'BLACKFRIDAY-EARLY' traffic x4". So maybe the cause is a marketing campaign causing high load. So root cause "traffic_spike". Service "web". We made the change. We should finish with cause "traffic_spike". Also we should double-check if any other services problematic? All healthy. So final answer.
